dimensions.assessment: Affects licensed hospitals seeking access to the mortgage insurance for hospitals program and the Department of Housing and Urban Development.
dimensions.evidence: To amend section 242 of the National Housing Act to provide parity with respect to access to the mortgage insurance for hospitals program for licensed hospitals

dimensions.assessment: Modifies access to a mortgage insurance program, potentially altering financing options for eligible licensed hospitals.
Changes the scope of entities eligible for federal mortgage insurance, though exact fiscal impacts or loan volume changes are not detailed.
Amends Section 242(b)(1) of the National Housing Act and mandates a study and report by HUD.
dimensions.evidence: Section 242(b)(1) of the National Housing Act (12 U.S.C. 1715z-7(b)(1)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: The statutory amendment is permanent, paired with a one-time report requirement due within two years.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill alters eligibility criteria for a federal mortgage insurance program for hospitals and requires a report on the program's expansion within two years.
